surface: supervised stream episode, evidence pull, learning loop, and reverse channel

findings.title: automatic retrieval ignores the documented layer/trust policy and injects Experience into action planning
findings.seam: tamoz-agent-memory Retrieval#recall automatic path → tamoz-agent-session SessionPlanningContext
findings.recommendation: Enforce the automatic layer/trust allowlist in Retrieval#recall before materialization and add a regression assertion that an active Experience row is never automatic; keep the policy at this existing seam.
findings.disposition: accepted open major; distinct from F19-SEC-01's verbatim-content framing finding

findings.title: the planning turn is not correlated with the memory it injects
findings.recommendation: Pass the current turn trace through the existing planning-context call chain and supply it to Retrieval#recall(trace:), retaining the existing memory_recalled payload.

findings.title: episode admission and behavior promotion use human gate for different artifacts
findings.recommendation: Use artifact-specific gate vocabulary in the memory and improvement design docs; keep F23-SEC-01 as the owner of the unbound promotion evidence.
findings.disposition: demoted from lead major; duplicate vocabulary face of F23-SEC-01 and accepted automatic episode-admission design
